risk_checks.name: Unusually high trading volume
risk_checks.value: 5.6% of market cap traded in 24 hours
risk_checks.threshold: More than 100% of market cap traded in 24 hours
risk_checks.measures: Turnover: 24-hour trading volume divided by market capitalisation.
risk_checks.meaning: When more than the whole market cap changes hands in a day, part of that volume is often wash trading (one party trading with itself to make a token look busy).

risk_checks.name: Thin market depth
risk_checks.value: $7,415,509 of selling moves the price 2% across 23 large-exchange markets
risk_checks.threshold: Less than $1,000,000 of selling moves the price 2%
risk_checks.measures: Depth: how many US Dollars of selling it takes to push the price down 2% on each order book, added up across large, established exchanges. Smaller exchanges are not counted.
risk_checks.meaning: Thin depth means a single large sale moves the price sharply (slippage). Deep books absorb large trades with little price change.

risk_checks.name: Large future supply (dilution)
risk_checks.value: Fully diluted value is 1.06 times market cap
risk_checks.threshold: Fully diluted value more than 3 times market cap
risk_checks.measures: FDV (fully diluted valuation): the market cap if every token that will ever exist were already in circulation.
risk_checks.meaning: A large gap means many tokens are still to be released. Each release adds supply, and existing holders own a smaller share of the total afterwards.

risk_checks.name: Most supply not yet circulating
risk_checks.measures: Float: circulating supply divided by maximum (or total) supply.
risk_checks.meaning: A low float means the price today is set by a small part of the supply. The rest is held by teams, investors or treasuries and can reach the market later.

risk_checks.name: Not tracked by major data sites
risk_checks.threshold: Absent from both CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap
risk_checks.measures: Coverage: whether independent market-data sites track the token.
risk_checks.meaning: Untracked tokens have less independent price and supply data, and scams are more common among them. A listing is not an endorsement either.

risk_checks.name: Large fall from all-time high
risk_checks.threshold: Price more than 70% below its all-time high
risk_checks.measures: Drawdown: how far the price sits below its highest recorded price.
risk_checks.meaning: A deep drawdown shows how volatile the token has been. It does not show whether the price will recover; many tokens never return to an earlier high.

risk_checks.name: Large price swing in 30 days
risk_checks.threshold: Price moved more than 30% up or down in 30 days
risk_checks.measures: Volatility: how much the price has moved over a recent period.
risk_checks.meaning: Large swings in either direction mean the value of any holding can change quickly.

risk_checks.name: Heavy leveraged trading
risk_checks.value: Open interest is 2.3% of market cap
risk_checks.threshold: Open interest above 10% of market cap
risk_checks.measures: Open interest: the value of futures contracts not yet closed, added up across the venues named in the source. Venues not named are not counted, so the true total is higher.
risk_checks.meaning: Heavy leverage can turn a small price move into a large one, because forced closures (liquidations) trigger more buying or selling.
risk_checks.source: OKX, Bitget, Gate and Hyperliquid public futures APIs (USDT-margined perpetuals)
